title: [The participation of the cholinergic structures of the prefrontal and inferotemporal cortices in visual recognition processes in monkeys].
abstract: Characteristics of visual recognition were impaired by amysil influence in monkeys. This was accompanied by a considerable activation of unit activity in the prefrontal cortex. Amysil induced a considerable drop in the cross-correlation coefficients between simultaneous responses of neuronal populations in prefrontal and inferotemporal cortex.
